=== THE DEFECT ===
No production settlement can correlate. Two ends of one comparison were built in different shapes:

PRODUCER (bare). task-03049148 (DONE, 93d4c3a) binds the reservation's attempt at `apps/daemon/src/activation/activation-budget-binding.ts:63 readonly attemptRef: string` / `:97` / `:101` — the BARE attemptId from the ingress. Its DoD 1 demands "attemptRef == the attempt", and the field name requires it. This is correct and must not be changed.

CONSUMER (composite). Every production measurement's `providerRunRef` is a length-prefixed flattening, minted at `packages/runner/src/providers/telemetry/provider-usage-normalization.ts:61-64`:
    function runRefOf(ref: ProviderRunRef): string {
      return `${ref.provider}:${ref.runRef.length}:${ref.runRef}:` +
        `${ref.attemptRef.length}:${ref.attemptRef}:${ref.epoch}`;

called at `:199` to fill `RowBase.providerRunRef` for every row the normalizer emits.

THE COMPARISON. `packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-settlement.ts:164`
    [readings.some((r) => r.run !== record.attemptRef), "BUDGET_SETTLEMENT_UNCORRELATED_MEASUREMENT"]
and the same test for reconcile at `:211`, where `r.run` is the reading's `providerRunRef` (`readMeasurement`, `:117-122`). Composite !== bare, so EVERY production settlement and EVERY production reconcile refuses. `settleBudgetReservation` and `reconcileBudgetSettlement` currently have ZERO production callers, which is why nothing is red today — task-a91e9fe2 is the row that wires the first one, and it will hit this on its first honest fixture.

WHY THE GREENS CANNOT SEE IT: `apps/daemon/src/budget/budget-transition-fixtures.ts:64` sets `providerRunRef: ATTEMPT` — the same literal that fills `attemptRef`. Every existing settlement green correlates by fixture construction, not by production shape. A fixture that keeps doing this is not evidence for this row.

=== THE OPTION SET — measured, deliberately NOT chosen. This is a contract decision and belongs to the planner. ===
(C) REDUCER SIDE: correlate on the composite's attemptRef segment at `:164`/`:211`. Mechanically sound — `runRefOf` is length-prefixed, so the segment parses unambiguously with no delimiter ambiguity even when a runRef contains ":". Cost: imports provider-run-ref format knowledge into @moe/scheduler.
(D) SCHEMA SIDE: carry `attemptRef` beside `providerRunRef` on the measurement and correlate on it. Cost: `MEASUREMENT_KEYS` (`budget-settlement.ts:54`) is a CLOSED 9-key list read through `hasOnlyOwnStringKeys`, and the same roster is duplicated at `packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-contract.ts:79`/`:228` and `apps/daemon/src/telemetry/provider-run-codec.validation.ts:187` — a schema bump with closed-enum churn at three sites. Note the identity is already structurally available: `ActivationProviderRunIdentity` (`activation-telemetry-launch.ts:70-76`) carries `attemptRef` as its own field, and `runRefOf` holds it bare in hand at `:63` before flattening.

(B) IS FORBIDDEN, not merely dispreferred: rewriting a reading's `providerRunRef` inside the composition to make it match. That alters measurement identity to satisfy a check — the "never synthesize / preserve the provider reader's truth" rails in another coat. a91e9fe2's planner refused to plan it; so do I.
(A) IS FORBIDDEN: binding the composite as the reservation's `attemptRef`. It stores a run ref in an attempt field and contradicts 03049148's landed DoD 1.

=== SCOPE ===
The correlation only. Not the settlement wiring (a91e9fe2 owns that), not cancelReservation (task-114e5e91), not the RESERVED/ACTIVATED binding (03049148, DONE).
